integrity: All computational checks are elementary exact sanity tests. The universal claims rely on the stated mathematical proof. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
limitations: Covers coarse quotients over the complex numbers for separable binary and smooth ternary cubic inputs only.
Does not compute integral cohomology, a smooth resolution, or the entire nonabelian group quotient.
Possible implicit antecedents in general cyclic-quotient literature remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Rational central cubic quotients with an elliptic noncanonical curve and four middle Betti classes
